verdict.rationale: The Division's public homepage links a "Check Entity Status" lookup and certificate validation, and the filing portal offers a public search-by-name for an entity file number. A founder can therefore see an entity's resulting status from public pages. Nothing shows a way to track an in-progress filing, name reservation, or other submission, and returns go back by mail. Missing for 10: public tracking of pending filings or applications, documented details of what the status lookup shows, hands-on or independent confirmation.
